notes.title: Hotfix 1.4
notes.content:
Hi, just updated the game to solve some bugs and add a few things:

[b]FIXED BUGS[/b]

• After load the game for the first time, the player hands appear without the pistol
• Player wasn't able to advance in the history if it comes to the tunnel without been pursuited by the werewolf
• Music bug after go in the tunnel
• Fixed some save points

[b]NEW WEAPON ADDED[/b]

Flamethrower: You can use this weapon for burn multiple enemies in area, also is very powerful and can be found after the salvage yard.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.2
notes.content:
Version 1.2 changelog:

• Now ammo are more easy to pickup.
• Enemies count has been reduced in the last town
• Fixed: Werewolf sometimes wasn´t able to hit the player
• Spawn rate of enemies decreased
• Added objective hint
• Added checkpoint at the end of salvage yard
• Added big wall at the end of the last town
• Health of crossbow enemies has been reduced

Enjoy! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Hotfix 1.1
notes.content:
Hi, i just fixed several bugs and also added some improves in this patch:

• Flying like a witch bug: There was a zone at the start of the game where you was able to fly, but now is fixed.

• Running animations fixed: The animation was triggered just by pressing left shift even when you was not moving.

• Added some optimizations in the vegetation

•The number of the enemies at the town was reduced a little bit

•Added Objective hint in when you pause the game

notes.title: Finally Released!
notes.content:
I am glad to announce that The Werewolf Hills is out now, it took more than i expected, cause there was a lot of bugs and improvements, but after test the game one hundred times, now is ready to play!.
If you have any questions or wanna leave a comment, please post it on the game forum, i will reading all.
Thank you to everyone that supports the game, i hope that all of you enjoy the game <3

Regards ːsteamhappyː
